items.description: Define the scope: the A1 conceptual model, the A2 openpilot v0.11.1 concrete model, and Perception as the detailed subsystem. Assign system, Perception and behaviour case identifiers.
items.expectedOutput: Scope statement, shared case-ID scheme and glossary.

items.description: Write the title, author information, abstract and introduction from the team’s completed analyses. Explain the comparison questions and report organisation.
items.expectedOutput: Group-authored opening sections; abstract about two-thirds of a page and introduction within Appendix A guidance.

items.description: Integrate the comparison tables, rationales, proposed fixes and revised diagrams. Keep each claim linked to its owner’s evidence and use the same subsystem names throughout.
items.expectedOutput: One coherent report draft with a common terminology and evidence index.

items.description: Check the complete report against Section 7 and Appendix A: 10–15 pages, 12-point single-spaced text, readable legends, references and clear changes to A1, A2 or both.
items.expectedOutput: Integrated report within the 15-page cap, including diagrams and appendices.

items.description: Publish the web-readable report and final PDF, interlink A1, A2 and A3, check every report/artifact link, and coordinate the group submission by December 6 at 11:59 PM.
items.expectedOutput: Final report, working website/PDF links and group handoff.

items.description: Read A1 Figure 1, Figure 2 and Table 1 (pp.3–5) alongside A2’s system views (pp.3–7) and Table 2 (p.8). Record the scope and meaning of each view.
items.expectedOutput: Baseline inventory and source-page references.

items.description: Build the A1-to-A2 subsystem mapping. Distinguish renamed, split, merged or differently scoped elements before classifying dependencies.
items.expectedOutput: Common mapping table and relation definitions.

items.description: Classify system-level relations as Absences, Convergences or Divergences. Recheck the cases listed in A2 Table 2 against the original A1 model.
items.expectedOutput: Top-level comparison matrix with evidence for each case.

items.description: Investigate why each top-level discrepancy exists using the report references and relevant source or history evidence. Separate documented explanations from the group’s interpretation.
items.expectedOutput: System-level rationale records with supporting sources and limitations.

items.description: Propose and justify a conceptual correction, a concrete change or both for the top-level cases. Provide before/after subsystem or dependency views and hand them over for integration.
items.expectedOutput: Top-level analysis section, revised-view proposals and change summary.

items.description: Identify Perception’s conceptual responsibility and relationships in A1 (pp.2–5), then read A2 Section 6, Table 3 and Figures 5–8 (pp.8–11).
items.expectedOutput: Detailed baseline inventory with report/page/figure references.

items.description: Map the conceptual Perception box to the concrete components and interfaces. Compare responsibilities, inputs, outputs and internal or cross-boundary dependencies.
items.expectedOutput: Perception mapping and detailed comparison matrix.

items.description: Classify detailed discrepancies after accounting for differences in abstraction. Keep static code dependencies, message communication and frame transport distinct.
items.expectedOutput: Detailed case records with relation types and evidence.

items.description: Investigate the rationale for each structural or interface discrepancy. Use the cited implementation evidence where needed and identify limits of static analysis.
items.expectedOutput: Evidence-backed explanations for the detailed design differences.

items.description: Propose and justify detailed conceptual or concrete changes. Show the original and proposed Perception boundaries/interfaces with readable legends and pass the changes to the report integrator.
items.expectedOutput: Detailed comparison section, revised Perception diagrams and case-linked proposals.

items.description: Use the slower/braking lead-vehicle scenario as a shared comparison: A1’s ACC sequence (Figure 3, p.10) and A2’s braking sequence (Figure 10, p.13). Define the common trigger and outcome.
items.expectedOutput: Scenario specification and baseline references.

items.description: Compare participating components, information flow, feedback and control responsibilities. Relate the scenario to the structural differences recorded by Spence and Mehdi.
items.expectedOutput: Paired scenario trace and linked behavioural cases.

items.description: Investigate the rationale and implications of each behavioural/interface difference using the A2 evidence references. Distinguish a source-derived trace from an observed runtime result.
items.expectedOutput: Behavioural rationale records with evidence and limits.

items.description: Propose conceptual scenario corrections or concrete interface/control-flow changes. Explain expected effects on coupling, timing or maintainability only where supported.
items.expectedOutput: Justified behavioural/interface proposals and a validation plan.

items.description: Produce a readable before/after sequence or state view and write the scenario comparison section using the same names and legends as the static views.
items.expectedOutput: Behaviour section, diagrams, captions and handoff to the integrator.

items.description: Collect the system-level, detailed Perception and behavioural case records. Check that each case cites both baselines and separates evidence from interpretation.
items.expectedOutput: Consolidated case register and coverage review.

items.description: Compare the owners’ mitigation alternatives: revise the conceptual model, propose a concrete change or change both. Explain why each selected option is preferable.
items.expectedOutput: Case-linked mitigation matrix with alternatives and rationale.

items.description: Describe expected benefits, costs, compatibility risks and a validation plan for the chosen proposals. Reconcile conflicts between the proposed revised views.
items.expectedOutput: Prioritised recommendations and consistent change summary.

items.description: Write conclusions and lessons from the completed comparison. Consolidate references and the required AI-use disclosure under the assignment’s A1 guidelines.
items.expectedOutput: Group-authored closing sections, references and applicable disclosures.

items.description: Review Section 7 coverage at both levels, the 10–15 page limit, legends, explicit before/after changes and website/report links. Return corrections to their owners for final integration.
items.expectedOutput: Final content review and report handoff to Setayesh.

checkpoints.label: System and detailed comparison cases assembled
Final deliverable and website links checked

submissionChecklist.label: Report compares the A1 conceptual and A2 concrete architectures
System-level and detailed Perception discrepancies have rationales
Each selected discrepancy has a justified mitigation proposal
Changes to the conceptual and concrete views are explicit
Report is 10–15 pages, within 15 including diagrams and appendices
Single-spaced 12-point text, abstract, introduction and references are included
Diagrams have clear legends and citations to the baseline evidence
Members author their sections and include required AI-use disclosures
Web report, final PDF and related assignment links work by December 6 at 11:59 PM
